name.en: Verify social assets in their target-size render
name.zh: 在目标尺寸渲染中验证社交素材

candidate_additions.reason: Distinct end-to-end method: concept approval, per-platform HTML artifacts, exact-size screenshot export, visual repair and traceable output report; no existing core candidate covers this production loop.

en.description: Produce social-image variants as separate target-sized artifacts, then check rendered exports before delivery.
en.scenario: Create a launch set for square feed posts and vertical story placements across two social platforms.
en.mechanism: Record each platform size, brand and content needs; draft distinct concepts and get approval before pixel work; create a self-contained HTML file for every approved concept and target size; capture each at its exact viewport after fonts and images settle; inspect exports for clipping, safe-zone, contrast and hierarchy issues; fix the HTML, recapture, and report the decisions and output files.
en.bad: Reuse one generic canvas for every platform and deliver source HTML without checking a target-size render, leaving cropped copy and fallback fonts undiscovered.
en.good: Keep separate square and vertical layouts, obtain concept approval, capture at target dimensions, repair a clipped headline, re-export and list each checked file in the report.
en.why: Source markup alone cannot show whether external fonts, viewport sizing or layout cause the exported image to clip or differ from intent.
en.expected: Each approved concept has an export at its declared size, visible rendering issues corrected and decisions/files recorded.
en.boundaries: Source dimensions, concept counts, wait times and text sizes are examples, not permanent platform standards. Recheck specs and asset readiness. Screenshot QA does not prove engagement; video, print, direct posting and AI image generation are outside scope.

zh.description: 将社交图片变体分别制作成目标尺寸的素材，并在交付前检查实际渲染结果。
zh.scenario: 为两个社交平台制作正方形信息流图片和竖版限时动态素材。
zh.mechanism: 记录各平台尺寸、品牌与内容要求；先提出不同创意并取得批准，再进入像素制作；为每个获批创意和目标尺寸建立独立、自包含的 HTML 文件；等待字体与图片就绪后按目标视口截图；检查裁切、安全区域、对比度和层级问题；修复 HTML、重新截图，并在报告中记录决策与输出文件。
zh.bad: 所有平台复用一张通用画布，不检查目标尺寸渲染就交付源 HTML，导致标题裁切、字体回退等问题未被发现。
zh.good: 分别保留正方形和竖版布局，先确认创意，再按目标尺寸截图；修复被裁切的标题，重新导出，并在报告中逐项列出检查过的文件。
zh.why: 只看源标记无法发现外部字体、视口尺寸或布局造成的导出裁切与视觉偏差。
zh.expected: 每个获批创意都有标明目标尺寸的导出图，已修复可见渲染问题，并记录相关决策和文件。
zh.boundaries: 源文档中的平台尺寸、创意数量、等待时间和字号都只是有限示例，不是永久的平台标准。应重新核对规格及素材加载状态。截图检查不能证明互动效果；视频、印刷、直接发布和 AI 图片生成均不属于此方法。

name.en: Persist a master design system with page-specific overrides
name.zh: 持久化全局设计系统与页面级覆盖

candidate_additions.reason: Distinct persistence/retrieval contract: keep shared project rules centrally and store page deviations separately; adjacent to contextual precedence but adds cross-session artifact layout and lookup.

en.description: Keep shared design rules in one project master and persist page-specific deviations separately for later retrieval.
en.scenario: A multi-page product has shared color, typography and spacing rules, while checkout needs a documented exception.
en.mechanism: Generate a project MASTER file for shared rules; create a page-specific file containing only deviations; when implementing a named page, look up that page file first and apply documented overrides, otherwise use the master. Make field-level merge or replacement semantics explicit.
en.bad: Copy the entire master into each page file, then edit copies independently so shared rules drift and no one knows which source wins.
en.good: Keep common tokens/components in MASTER.md, record only checkout-specific deviations in pages/checkout.md, and tell implementers how those deviations interact with the master.
en.why: Durable shared defaults and local exceptions remain discoverable across sessions without silently conflating precedence.
en.expected: A reviewer can locate the project baseline, page-specific delta and stated precedence used for that page.
en.boundaries: The source proposes page overrides but leaves field-level merge versus replacement underspecified; define semantics before relying on partial files. This pattern does not validate token values or guarantee runtime retrieval.

zh.description: 将共享设计规则保存在项目主文件中，并把页面专属偏差单独持久化以便后续检索。
zh.scenario: 多页面产品已有共享颜色、字体和间距规则，而结账页需要一项明确记录的例外。
zh.mechanism: 为共享规则生成项目 MASTER 文件；另建页面文件，只记录偏差；实现具名页面时先查找该页面文件并应用其中明确说明的覆盖规则，否则使用主文件。明确字段级合并或替换语义。
zh.bad: 把主文件完整复制到每个页面文件后分别修改，使共享规则逐渐漂移，也让执行者无法判断应以哪份规则为准。
zh.good: 在 MASTER.md 保存通用 token 和组件，只在 pages/checkout.md 记录结账页偏差，并说明这些偏差与主文件的交互方式。
zh.why: 跨会话仍能找到持久化的共享默认规则和局部例外，也不会默默混淆优先级。
zh.expected: 审阅者能定位项目基线、页面专属差异，以及该页面采用的明确优先规则。
zh.boundaries: 源文档提出页面覆盖，但没有充分说明字段级合并还是替换；依赖部分文件前应先定义语义。该模式本身不会验证 token 数值，也不保证运行时一定检索到文件。
